svg.title: Business Bytes
svg.desc: Business Bytes: An India-themed Monopoly board game for the desktop. 2–4 player hot-seat play across Indian cities. Rent tiers, house building, debt and a shared bank. Save & resume games per account, backed by MySQL. Custom circular data structure for the board. Built with Java, JavaFX, MySQL, Maven.
